desc: Rise and shine with delicious French Toast Crunch Cereal. These mini, crunchy French toast flavored cereal pieces are bursting with syrup and cinnamon taste. They're a great way to get everyone running to the breakfast table! Pour a bowl with milk and leave yourself time to slurp up that yummy cereal milk at the bottom of your bowl. Every serving provides 12 vitamins and minerals, 13g whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily), and a good source of calcium. This kids cereal is a favorite with grown ups, too. Enjoy French Toast Crunch cereal any way you like. Sprinkle the French toast flavored cereal piece over a sundae as ice cream toppings. Nibble from a bowlful as party snacks. Or pack some crispy cereal in a school snack bag. Whether you're looking for delicious kids snacks, trail mix ingredients, or a cinnamon cereal for the whole family, General Mills cereals spread goodness from tots to grown-ups. Contains one cardboard box of crunchy French Toast Crunch Breakfast Cereal, Syrup and Cinnamon Taste, Family Size, 17.4 oz; Perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals.
features:
MINI FRENCH TOAST SHAPES: Bite-size French toast flavored pieces bursting with the irresistible taste of syrup and cinnamon

MADE WITH REAL CINNAMON: Crispy and delicious sweetened corn cereal made with real cinnamon

WHOLE GRAIN: 12 vitamins and minerals, plus 13g whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily) per serving; A good source of calcium

PART OF BREAKFAST OR SNACK: Enjoy some with milk or by itself as a tasty addition to breakfast, snack time, or whenever

CONTAINS: One cardboard box of crunchy French Toast Crunch Breakfast Cereal, Syrup and Cinnamon Taste, Family Size, 17.4 oz; Perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals
ingredients: Whole Grain Corn, Sugar, Corn Meal, Corn Syrup, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Salt, Refiner's Syrup, Cinnamon, Color (caramel color, annatto extract, turmeric extract), Natural Flavor, Rosemary Extract. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), Vitamin B12, A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin D3.
